<thought>After attempting to locate a suitable template using bond criteria, no matches were found. The next best approach is to search by functional groups that are formed in the Still‑Gennari HWE reaction: a C‑C double bond and a carboxylic ester. The aldehyde is consumed, so we include “aldehydes” as a broken functional group. This search should return the relevant template if it exists in the database.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C=C\\C(=O)O",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds", "carboxylic esters"],
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
